summary: Usage settings page: 'Unlimited' per-signal quota rows are now hidden only when the combined telemetry.max_bytes_monthly quota is capped (hosted plan), instead of whenever any quota is capped; the 'Bytes ingested' card is renamed 'Log bytes ingested'.

statements.why: packages/frontend/src/lib/utils/usage-capabilities.ts:18-20 changes which rows the Usage page shows, and usage/+page.svelte:303 renames a visible card title. Visible (minor) UI change.

misses.what: Self-hosters who cap a single quota (e.g. spans) now see all their other quotas listed as 'Unlimited' on Settings > Usage again; only hosted plans with a combined telemetry cap hide them.
The Usage page card 'Bytes ingested' is now labelled 'Log bytes ingested'.
